```{r}
# define functions
RPM <- function(x) ((x/sum(x) *1000000) + 1)
average <- function(x,y) ((x + y) /2)
L2FC <- function(x,y) (log2(x/y))
zscore <- function(x) ((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
```

```{r}
# read in the library table for short pycroquet test run with the guide + scaffold + extension
lib <- as_tibble(read.csv("pegRNA_Twist_12k_251124.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))
lib
```

```{r}
#make a libray for pycroquet exact mapping
evopreq <- "CGCGGTTCTATCTAGTTACGCGTTAAACCAACTAGAATTTTTTT"
scaffold <- "gtttaagagCTATGCTGGAAACAGCATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGCACCGAGTCGgtgc"

KRAS_pyc_forward_151  <-
  lib %>%
  select(id, gRNA, extension) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreq)) %>%
    mutate(sgrna_seqs = str_to_upper(sgrna_seqs)) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = substr(sgrna_seqs, 0, 151)) %>%
  mutate(len = nchar(sgrna_seqs)) %>%
  write.csv("KRAS_pyc_forward_151.csv")
```

```{r}
# compare the read counting from pycroquet (guide + scaffold + extension - forward.fastq) and LUCA (reverse, guide + extension)

#LUCA results read in results counts for extension + guide

# Get list of all matching files
files <- list.files(path = "./results_counts", pattern = "combination.0.counts.tsv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# Function to process each file
read_and_rename <- function(file) {
  # Read the file (no header)
  df <- read_tsv(file, col_names = FALSE)

  # Extract the directory name containing counts
  dir_name <- dirname(file)
  sample_name <- basename(dir_name)  # this is the WT/mut-containing folder

  # Determine sensor type
  sensor_col <- if (grepl("counts", sample_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "sensor_LUCA_WT"
  } else if (grepl("mut", sample_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "sensor_LUCA_mut"
  } else {
    stop(paste("Directory does not contain 'WT' or 'mut':", sample_name))
  }

  # Rename columns
  colnames(df) <- c("gRNA", "extension", sample_name)

  return(df)
}

# Read and process all files
tables <- lapply(files, read_and_rename)

# Reduce by left_join on common columns (gRNA, extension)
joined_table <- reduce(tables, function(x, y) {
  join_cols <- intersect(names(x)[1:3], names(y)[1:3])
  left_join(x, y, by = join_cols)
})

# View result
read_table_R <- 
  joined_table %>%
  select(-contains(".y")) %>%
  select(-contains(".x"))

print(read_table_R)
```

```{r}
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "pycroquet_151", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-`#id`, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna_ids)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_pyc_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
reads <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

reads
```

```{r}
# PE Coverage Estimation

#read in the protein datafram output csv for BEstimate for CBE and ABE
#these assume a leninet window of bases from 3-9 nt in the gRNA are edited - base editing activity window

#filter CBE data to include only non-synonymous variants with numerical Protein_Position
heat_map <- 
  join_data %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS") %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  filter(mutation_type == "missense") %>%
    distinct()

# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 200 residues)
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table twith the gRNAs by Protein_Position

Coverage <-
  left_join(Protein, heat_map)

#identify the number of missing amino acids (NA gRNA)
Missing <- 
  Coverage %>%
  filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count()

#calculate the % coverage by non-synonymous amino acid mutations with CBE and ABE
(Length-Missing)/Length*100

#summarise the BE coverage data with a histogram
plot1 <- ggplot(Coverage, aes(x=amino_acid_position, fill = mutation_type)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
theme_classic()

#print the plot
plot1
```

```{r}
#heatmap showing na values and mean value - scaled by ROW

# Select only columns ending in "z_score" and amino_acid_position
df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
  select(amino_acid_position, ends_with("plasmid_average_zscore")) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid_position) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%  # Keep NAs
  arrange(amino_acid_position)

# --- Make sure we include ALL amino acid positions (1 to Length) ---
Length <- 189
all_positions <- tibble(amino_acid_position = 1:Length)

df_numeric <- all_positions %>%
  left_join(df_numeric, by = "amino_acid_position")

# Convert to matrix
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric %>% column_to_rownames("amino_acid_position"))

# Ensure columns are ordered numerically
df_matrix <- df_matrix[, order(as.numeric(colnames(df_matrix)))]

# Transpose the matrix so positions are on x-axis
df_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

# Generate the heatmap
plot1 <- pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Keep AA positions in order
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "Heatmap of KRAS",
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200),
  border_color = NA,
  na_col = "grey"   # <--- This makes NA values appear grey
)
plot1
```

```{r}
#define the mutated sequence
target_seq <- 
  lib %>% 
  mutate(target_seq = ifelse(sensor_orientation == "forward", rc_sensor, sensor)) %>%
   select(id, target_seq, sensor_orientation, sensor, rc_sensor, extension, Twist_oligo, sequence_name) 

#function to make a list of intended sensor edits
replace_with_mutation <- function(target, ext) {
  if (is.na(target) || is.na(ext)) return(NA_character_)
  
  ext_len <- nchar(ext)
  target_len <- nchar(target)
  
  if (target_len < ext_len) return(NA_character_)
  
  ext_upper <- toupper(ext)
  
  for (i in 1:(target_len - ext_len + 1)) {
    sub_seq <- substr(target, i, i + ext_len - 1)
    
    # Count number of mismatches
    mismatches <- sum(strsplit(sub_seq, "")[[1]] != strsplit(ext_upper, "")[[1]])
    
    if (mismatches == 1) {
      return(paste0(
        substr(target, 1, i - 1),
        ext,
        substr(target, i + ext_len, target_len)
      ))
    }
  }
  
  return(NA_character_)  # No match found
}

# write the expected mutation in the sensor sequence
target_seq <-
  target_seq %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(mutated_target_seq = replace_with_mutation(target_seq, extension)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  select(sequence_name, target_seq, mutated_target_seq, extension, sensor, id)  %>%
  rename(WT_sensor = target_seq) %>%
  mutate(mutated_sensor = str_to_upper(mutated_target_seq)) %>%
  mutate(WT_sensor = ifelse(str_detect(id, "non-targeting"), sensor, WT_sensor)) %>%
  mutate(mutated_sensor = ifelse(str_detect(id, "non-targeting"), sensor, mutated_sensor)) %>%
  select(sequence_name, WT_sensor, mutated_sensor, id) %>%
  distinct()

target_seq
```

```{r}
#LUCA results read in results for WT and mut sensors

# Get list of all matching files
files <- list.files(path = "./results_sensor", pattern = "combination.0.counts.tsv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# Function to process each file
read_and_rename <- function(file) {
  # Read the file (no header)
  df <- read_tsv(file, col_names = FALSE)

  # Extract the directory name containing WT or mut
  dir_name <- dirname(file)
  sample_name <- basename(dir_name)  # this is the WT/mut-containing folder

  # Determine sensor type
  sensor_col <- if (grepl("WT", sample_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "sensor_LUCA_WT"
  } else if (grepl("mut", sample_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "sensor_LUCA_mut"
  } else {
    stop(paste("Directory does not contain 'WT' or 'mut':", sample_name))
  }

  # Rename columns
  colnames(df) <- c("gRNA", "extension", sensor_col, paste0(sample_name, "_counts"))

  return(df)
}

# Read and process all files
tables <- lapply(files, read_and_rename)

# Reduce by left_join on common columns (gRNA, extension, sensor column)
joined_table <- reduce(tables, function(x, y) {
  join_cols <- intersect(names(x)[1:3], names(y)[1:3])
  left_join(x, y, by = join_cols)
})

# Optional: write to output
# write_tsv(joined_table, "LUCA_combined_counts.tsv")

# View result
sensor_table <- 
  joined_table %>%
  select(-contains(".y")) %>%
  select(-contains(".x"))

sensor_table
```

```{r}
# generate % editing for each value

# Function to add editing % for a single var
add_editing_percentage <- function(df, var_prefix) {
  wt_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_WT_counts")
  mut_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_mut_counts")
  new_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_editing")

  if (!all(c(wt_col, mut_col) %in% names(df))) {
    warning(paste("Skipping:", var_prefix, "- missing WT or mut columns."))
    return(df)
  }

  df[[new_col]] <- ifelse(
    df[[wt_col]] + df[[mut_col]] == 0,
    NA,
    df[[mut_col]] / (df[[wt_col]] + df[[mut_col]]) * 100
  )

  return(df)
}

# Function to detect all var prefixes and apply percentage function
add_all_editing_percentages <- function(df) {
  wt_cols <- grep("_WT_counts$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  vars <- sub("_WT_counts$", "", wt_cols)

  for (var_prefix in vars) {
    df <- add_editing_percentage(df, var_prefix)
  }

  return(df)
}

join_data <- 
  add_all_editing_percentages(join_data)

join_data
```

```{r}
# make an average editing rate for each condition

r1_cols <- names(sensor_editing_data)[
  str_detect(names(sensor_editing_data), "R1") & 
  str_detect(names(sensor_editing_data), "editing")
]

# Loop through each R1 column to calculate average with corresponding R2
for (r1_col in r1_cols) {
  # Extract the base variable name by removing "_R1" but keeping "_editing"
  base_name <- str_remove(r1_col, "_R1")
  
  # Construct corresponding R2 and output average column names
  r2_col  <- str_replace(r1_col, "_R1", "_R2")
  avg_col <- str_replace(base_name, "_editing$", "_average_editing")
  
  # Check that the R2 column exists
  if (r2_col %in% names(sensor_editing_data)) {
    sensor_editing_data <- sensor_editing_data %>%
      mutate(!!avg_col := rowMeans(across(all_of(c(r1_col, r2_col))), na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    warning(paste("R2 column not found for:", base_name))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Check that the reference column exists
if (!reference_col %in% names(sensor_editing_data)) {
  stop("Reference column 'Plasmid_8132stdy_editing' not found in the dataset.")
}

# Get all columns ending in _average_editing
editing_cols <- names(sensor_editing_data)[str_detect(names(sensor_editing_data), "_editing$")]

# Loop through and create corrected columns
for (editing_cols in editing_cols) {
  if (editing_cols != reference_col) {
    corrected_col <- str_replace(editing_cols, "_editing$", "_corrected_editing")
    
    sensor_editing_data <- sensor_editing_data %>%
      mutate(!!corrected_col := .data[[editing_cols]] - .data[[reference_col]])
  }
}

sensor_editing_data %>%
  select(contains ("_corrected_editing"))
```

```{r}
#now calculate unintended editing (difference between summed WT and mut counts and the total counts with just guide + extension mapped)

# Find all _summed_counts columns
summed_cols <- names(sensor_editing_data)[str_detect(names(sensor_editing_data), "_summed_counts")]
summed_cols
# Loop through each and compute unintended editing
for (summed_col in summed_cols) {
  # Get base name (remove _summed_counts)
  base_name <- str_replace(summed_col, "_summed_counts", "")
  
  # Original total counts column (e.g., gene1_counts)
  original_col <- paste0(base_name, "_Rcounts")
  
  # Name for the new unintended_editing column
  unintended_col <- paste0(base_name, "_unintended_editing")
  
  if (original_col %in% names(sensor_editing_data)) {
    sensor_editing_data[[unintended_col]] <- 
      ((sensor_editing_data[[original_col]] - sensor_editing_data[[summed_col]]) / 
         sensor_editing_data[[original_col]]) * 100
  } else {
    warning(paste("Missing original counts column for:", summed_col))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#make a library sequence for Twist with Gibson assembly arms
GA_F <- "TATCTTGTGGAAAGGACGAAAcaccG"

GA_R <- "CGCGGTTCTATCTAGTTACGCGT"

scaffold <-
  "GTTTAagagCTATGCTGGAAACAGCATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGCACCGAGTCGGTGC"

#make a gblock for Twist
sc_lib_filtered <-
  sc_lib_filtered %>%
  mutate(g_block = str_to_upper(paste0(GA_F, gRNA, scaffold, extension, GA_R)))

sensor_editing_data <-
  sensor_editing_data %>%
  mutate(g_block = str_to_upper(paste0(GA_F, gRNA, scaffold, extension, GA_R)))

#add lib_class
sc_lib_filtered <-
  sc_lib_filtered %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% editing$id, "editing", "" )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance$id, "resistance", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance_KRAS$id, "resistance", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% deleterious$id, "deleterious", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% synonymous$id, "synonymous", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% non_coding$id, "non_coding", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% tumour_suppressors$id, "tumour_suppressors", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% non_targeting$id, "non_targeting", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance_KRAS_synonymous$id, "validation", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% validation$id, "validation", lib_class )) %>%
        mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% RBM10$id, "RBM10", lib_class ))


#write the library file
sc_lib_filtered %>%
  select(gene, id, sequence_name, gRNA, extension, g_block, mutation, mutation_type, Count, COSMIC_mutation, Region, Gene_role, lib_class, Plasmid_8132stdy_WT_counts, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_RMC_end_average_editing, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_R1_end_unintended_editing,A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_R2_end_unintended_editing, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_BI_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_MRTX_plasmid_average_zscore) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(gene) %>%
  write.csv("sc_lib.csv")
```

```{r}
#read in protvar data for KRAS
protvar_KRAS <- as_tibble(read.csv("P01116-fun-pop-str.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

protvar_KRAS <-
  protvar_KRAS %>%
  rename(gene = Gene) %>%
    rename(amino_acid_position = Amino_acid_position) %>%
      rename(mutation_type = Consequences) %>%
  rename(protvar_mutation = Amino_acid_change)

# Three-letter to one-letter lookup table
aa_dict <- c(
  Ala = "A", Arg = "R", Asn = "N", Asp = "D",
  Cys = "C", Gln = "Q", Glu = "E", Gly = "G",
  His = "H", Ile = "I", Leu = "L", Lys = "K",
  Met = "M", Phe = "F", Pro = "P", Ser = "S",
  Thr = "T", Trp = "W", Tyr = "Y", Val = "V"
)

protvar_KRAS <- 
  protvar_KRAS %>%
  mutate(
    # Split mutation into ref and alt
    ref_aa = str_split(protvar_mutation, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,1],
    alt_aa = str_split(protvar_mutation, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,2],
    # Convert to one-letter using the dictionary
    ref_aa1 = aa_dict[ref_aa],
    alt_aa1 = aa_dict[alt_aa],
    # Build mutation string like M1I
    mutation = paste0(ref_aa1, amino_acid_position, alt_aa1)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

left_join(sensor_editing_data, protvar_KRAS) %>%
  filter(is.na(Diseases_associated_with_variant) == FALSE) %>%
    filter(Diseases_associated_with_variant != "N/A") %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, mutation, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore, Diseases_associated_with_variant, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing)

protvar_join <-
  left_join(sensor_editing_data, protvar_KRAS) %>%
  distinct()

protvar_join
sensor_editing_data
```

```{r}
#simplify and unify disease associations

plot_data <-
  protvar_join %>%
    mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Diseases_associated_with_variant, "RASopathy"), "RASopathy", Diseases_associated_with_variant)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "Noonan"), "Noonan", Disease)) %>%
    mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "Inborn"), "Inborn genetic diseases", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "Cardiofaciocutaneous"), "CFC", Disease)) %>%
    mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "Neoplasm"), "Neoplasm", Disease)) %>%
    mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "NA"), "NA", Disease)) %>%
    mutate(Disease = ifelse(str_detect(Disease, "N/A"), "NA", Disease)) %>%
      mutate(Disease = ifelse(is.na(Disease)==TRUE, "NA", Disease))

plot_data %>%
  count(Disease)
```

```{r}
# crispresso2 Pooled prepare files quantifying between pos 3 and position 48 of the sensor and taking fastqs with 50 reads
#this is in line iwth the max extension boundaries vefore and after the edit in the senor

scaffold <- str_to_upper("gtttaagagCTATGCTGGAAACAGCATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGCACCGAGTCGgtgc")

evopreQ_term <- "CGCGGTTCTATCTAGTTACGCGTTAAACCAACTAGAATTTTTTT"

join_data %>%
  select(sensor, extension_before_variant) %>%
  mutate(nt = str_count(extension_before_variant)) %>%
  arrange((nt))

join_data %>%
  select(sensor, extension_after_variant) %>%
  mutate(nt = str_count(extension_after_variant)) %>%
  arrange((nt))

amplicons_files <- sensor_editing_data %>%
  rename(amplicon_name = id) %>%
  mutate(amplicon_seq = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreQ_term, sensor_LUCA_WT)) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq = gRNA) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq = extension) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_scaffold_seq = "GGCACCGAGUCGGUGC") %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_override_prime_edited_ref_seq = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreQ_term, sensor_LUCA_mut)) %>%
  mutate(quantification_window_coordinates = paste0((105+extension_length+44+2), "-", (105+extension_length+44+48))) %>%
  select(amplicon_name, amplicon_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_scaffold_seq, prime_editing_override_prime_edited_ref_seq, quantification_window_coordinates) %>%
  distinct()

#filter out non-targeting pegRNAs
amplicons_files <-
amplicons_files %>%
  filter(str_detect(amplicon_name, "non-target") == FALSE)
amplicons_files

#CRISPRessoPooled (CRISPResso2) wants to reverse comp the extension sequence!
amplicons_files <-
  amplicons_files %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq = str_to_upper(reverseComplement(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq))) %>%
    mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq = str_to_upper(reverseComplement(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq)))

amplicons_files %>%
  write_tsv("amplicons_files.tsv")
```

```{r}
theme_classic()
```

```{r}
#for Pymol b-factor structure mapping of variant effects in 3D

#control
B_CTRL_prime <- sensor_editing_data %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore, mutation_type) %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS") %>%
  filter(mutation_type =="missense") %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid_position) %>%
  summarise(min_score_CTRL = min(L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore)) %>%
  distinct()
B_CTRL_prime

sensor_editing_data %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS") %>%
    select(mutation, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore) %>%
  group_by(mutation) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore)) %>%
  distinct()
  
#ACBI3
B_ACBI3_prime <- sensor_editing_data %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore, mutation_type) %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS") %>%
    filter(mutation_type =="missense") %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid_position) %>%
  summarise(max_score_ACBI3 = max(L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore)) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 796 residues)
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.integer(amino_acid_position))

Protein
```

```{r}
#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table twith the gRNAs by Protein_Position
#Amino acid positions impute NA to 0
B_CTRL_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_CTRL_prime) %>%
  mutate(min_score_CTRL = ifelse(is.na(min_score_CTRL)==TRUE, 0, min_score_CTRL))
  
B_ACBI3_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_ACBI3_prime) %>%
  mutate(max_score_ACBI3 = ifelse(is.na(max_score_ACBI3)==TRUE, 0, max_score_ACBI3))

B_RMC_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_RMC_prime) %>%
  mutate(max_score_RMC = ifelse(is.na(max_score_RMC)==TRUE, 0, max_score_RMC))
```

```{r}
#make a dot plot graph of resistance mutations
df_long_zscore <- 
  sensor_editing_data %>%
  filter(id %in% c(hits$id)) %>%
  select(id, gene, amino_acid_position, sequence_name, mutation_type, mutation, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_BI_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_MRTX_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_plasmid_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_plasmid_average_zscore) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, sequence_name, gene, mutation, mutation_type, amino_acid_position), names_to = "drug", values_to = "z_score") %>%
  distinct()

df_long_editing <- 
  sensor_editing_data %>%
  filter(id %in% c(hits$id)) %>%
  select(id, gene, amino_acid_position, sequence_name, mutation, mutation_type, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_RMC_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_BI_2863_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_MRTX_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_ACBI3_end_average_corrected_editing) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, sequence_name, gene, mutation, mutation_type, amino_acid_position), names_to = "drug", values_to = "editing") %>%
  distinct()

df_long_zscore <-
  df_long_zscore %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_FLARE_"), "control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_ACBI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))

df_long_editing <-
  df_long_editing %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_FLARE_"), "control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_ACBI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))

#join editing and zscore
df_long <- 
  left_join(df_long_zscore, df_long_editing)

#filter by 5 % editing and missense
df_long <-
  df_long %>%
  filter(editing >5) %>%
  filter(mutation_type != "synonymous")

df_long <-
  df_long %>%
  mutate(mutation_id = paste(gene, mutation, id)) %>%
  distinct()

df_long
```

```{r}
  rename(amino_acid_position = Position) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove(AA.Mutation, "p.")) %>%
  rename(exact_COSMIC_count = Count) %>%
  select(!c(CDS.Mutation, Type, AA.Mutation)) %>%
    mutate(gene = "EGFR") %>%
  filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_replace_all(mutation, "\\*", "STOP")) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            height = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "COSMIC count",

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Make sure the  bar is visible
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(fill = "COSMIC count")
```

```{r}
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Make sure the  bar is visible
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(fill = "COSMIC count")
plot1
#ggsave("Fig2_dots_1.eps", width = 4, height = 3, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
#dot plots individial genes
TP53 <- 
  df_long_filtered %>%
  filter(gene == "TP53")

#cosmic bar
cosmic_bar <- TP53 %>%
  distinct(mutation_id, gene, exact_COSMIC_count) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = max(as.numeric(factor(df_long_filtered$drug))) + 1)

#plot
plot1 <- ggplot(TP53,
                aes(x = mutation_id, y = drug, colour = z_score, size = editing)) +
  geom_point() +
  ylab("")+
  # Add top bar
  geom_tile(data = cosmic_bar,
            aes(x = mutation_id, y = y_pos, fill = exact_COSMIC_count),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            height = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "COSMIC count", 
                       trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10, sigma = 1),
    labels = scales::comma_format()) +  
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  # Make sure the  bar is visible
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(fill = "COSMIC count")
plot1
#ggsave("Fig2_dots_2.eps", width = 4, height = 3, path ="./figures_export")
```
